**Recommended one-shot formulation:**

- **Ethanol:** **45.0 v/v%**
- **SDS:** **0.75 w/v%**

**Rationale:** The best valid result so far was near `34.6% ethanol / 0.75% SDS`, giving **68.108°**. Since the contact angle is still ~3° too high, I would keep SDS near the best observed value and increase ethanol substantially to drive the contact angle lower. **45% ethanol** is high enough to plausibly reach ~65° but avoids pushing all the way to the 50% boundary.
